name: The service worker controls the page; empty session
A route with turns and points of interest of several kinds exported as FIT
Opening the FIT file gives back the same route and waypoints (types, names, coordinates as text)
Save writes a new GPX file (suggested from the route name) in the saved format; the FIT file is not overwritten
eval:
const t = textForSave().text;
return { suggested: suggestedFileName(), overwrite: /overwrite/.test(btnSave.title), creator: /<gpx creator="Suunto Routeplanner"/.test(t), turns: (t.match(/<type>\w*_turn<\/type>/g) || []).length, roundabout: t.includes('<name>Roundabout, exit 2</name><type>Roundabout_exit_2_turn</type>'), named: t.includes('<name>Spring under the oak</name><type>Water</type>') }

name: A FIT activity recorded on a watch: big-endian definitions, compressed timestamps, developer fields, enhanced altitude, records without a position, a course point with only a distance
Course points from other apps: Garmin types to Suunto types, a name kept, a name that is a type's label gives that type
A FIT file without positions and a damaged one are refused with a message; the open route stays

expect.t1: Could not open Workout.fit: There is no route in it. Only a course or an activity recorded with GPS can be opened.
expect.t2: Could not open Broken.fit: The FIT file is damaged.

name: File → Open offers GPX and FIT files and opens a FIT file without its handle
Open with on a computer: a FIT file opens, its handle is dropped (Save must not write GPX into it)
The manifest accepts FIT files for Open with and Share
eval:
const m = await (await fetch('manifest.json')).json();
return { handler: m.file_handlers[0].accept['application/vnd.ant.fit'], gpx: m.file_handlers[0].accept['application/gpx+xml'], share: ['.fit', 'application/vnd.ant.fit', '.gpx'].every(a => m.share_target.params.files[0].accept.includes(a)) }

name: Sharing a FIT file into the app (Android)
The shared FIT file is open as a new GPX file
eval: return { name: gpx?.fileName, handle: gpx?.handle, dirty: gpx?.dirty, wpts: wptItems.filter(w => !w.fixed).length === +sessionStorage.getItem('__fitWpts'), stored: await caches.has(SHARE_CACHE), search: location.search }
